description: Eight source-grounded artist/architecture studies; preview observation and curator/creator context separated from digital transfer hypotheses.

entries.title: Woman Holding a Balance
entries.creator: Johannes Vermeer
entries.mechanism: Local light and spatial relations can prioritize quiet human action without flattening secondary content.

entries.title: Under the Wave off Kanagawa
entries.creator: Katsushika Hokusai
entries.mechanism: Large foreground energy can coexist with a small stable reference, without requiring literal imagery reuse.
entries.rights: Met catalog marks this impression image Public Domain

entries.title: Nighthawks
entries.creator: Edward Hopper
entries.mechanism: Luminous inhabited space framed by darkness suggests a story; deliberately absent entry is anti-pattern for product navigation.
entries.rights: Museum and third-party photo rights to review

entries.title: Simpatico poster
entries.creator: Paula Scher
entries.mechanism: Overwhelming display type can build cultural identity if utility information remains reliably legible.
entries.rights: Commercial identity and museum store photo; permission required for reproduction

entries.title: Study for Homage to the Square: Light Rising
entries.creator: Josef Albers
entries.mechanism: Color impact changes with adjacent surfaces; artistic value contrast is not accessibility compliance.
entries.rights: NGA expressly does not provide media download; request image-use permission

entries.title: Church of the Light
entries.creator: Tadao Ando Architect & Associates
entries.mechanism: Spatial restraint and a focused reveal can express meaning, not justify delaying digital tasks.
entries.rights: Architect-authored account; third-party photo and RIBA drawing rights are separate

entries.title: American Gothic, Washington, D.C.
entries.creator: Gordon Parks
entries.mechanism: Portrait framing only has ethical/design force when identity, lived context and consent are understood; don't manufacture documentary authenticity.
entries.rights: Gordon Parks Foundation/LOC and specific photographic print rights require clearance

entries.title: Out to Lunch! album cover
entries.creator: Reid Miles (cover design); Eric Dolphy (album)
entries.mechanism: An unexpected subject-specific visual metaphor can pair with accurate artist information; the visual should not impersonate operational status or copy an existing label identity.
entries.rights: Blue Note/photographer/graphic artwork rights; independent collector preview not cleared for republication
